stats.text:
If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any {ref:glossary/advantage} on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn. The chosen attack roll mustn't have {ref:glossary/disadvantage}. If the chosen attack roll hits, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or {ref:glossary/unarmed-strike}, and you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice. You have the following effect options.

***Forceful Blow.*** The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you. You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks}.

***Hamstring Blow.*** The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. A target can be affected by only one Hamstring Blow at a time—the most recent one.
